title: WHO calls for action: “Together for health. Stand with science.” to mark World Health Day
summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) today calls on people everywhere to renew their commitment to working together and supporting science as the twin engines driving better health, under the World Health Day 2026 theme: “Together for health.
